description: Start signing a person up. Sends a sign-in email to their work address. No API key needed. Ask the person for their own work email and name first. Personal addresses such as gmail.com are refused. The email holds a code, a sign-in link or both. Ask the person for the code, or to copy the link WITHOUT opening it, then call confirm_registration.

heard_from.description: Where the person heard about Agent Meets Agent, in a few words (for example: Reddit, a blog post, a colleague). Ask once, in passing. Leave out if they do not say.

name: register
